prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE new full-body standing sprite of original Japanese private detective Saeki Minato, age 38, for a contemporary Japanese detective ADV. The provided image is the sole identity, costume and painting-style reference. Match its central standing man closely; do not reproduce its sheet layout.
Appearance: angular adult face, tired heavy eyelids, restrained neutral closed mouth, light uneven stubble, tousled black hair, lean tall adult proportions. No glasses. Worn charcoal short suit jacket, rumpled off-white shirt with open collar, loosely worn matte black necktie, dark trousers, plain worn black leather shoes. Relaxed shoulders, both hands naturally in trouser pockets, slight three-quarter stance and gaze towards screen right matching reference. No smoking object or smoke.
Medium: late-1990s PS1 detective adventure hand-painted gekiga original artwork. Preserve the reference's visibly irregular ink strokes, broken contours, coarse brush marks and patchy pigment inside the figure. Use bold asymmetrical angular shadow planes on cheek, neck, hair and clothing, not smooth gradients. Muted charcoal, grey-brown, ochre skin, slightly faded pigment; adult fatigue, melancholy and lived-in cloth. Readable face and separate cloth planes even within dark values. Do not polish or beautify the face. No modern beautiful anime rendering, glossy hair, airbrushed skin, photorealism, vector lines, sepia filter, digital noise overlay or deliberately low resolution.
Composition: portrait canvas ideally 1024x1536, one centered complete standing figure, head through both complete shoe soles visible with modest clear margin; no cropping. Genuinely transparent background outside character including between limbs. Painted texture only INSIDE the character, no paper backdrop, no environment, no ground shadow, no text, names, border, expression panels or palette. This is a new drawing rather than a cutout of the sheet.
